input.questionText: Explain why vanishing gradients happen in deep sigmoid networks and how ReLU helps.
input.studentAnswer: Repeated multiplication of small sigmoid derivatives under 0.25 makes early gradients shrink exponentially, while ReLU has a constant derivative of 1 for positive inputs.
input.referenceAnswer: Repeated multiplication of small sigmoid derivatives causes early-layer gradients to shrink exponentially; ReLU keeps derivative equal to 1 for positive inputs.
requiredKeyPoints: Repeated multiplication of small sigmoid derivatives shrinks gradients
ReLU has constant derivative 1 for positive inputs
